2026 tennis event results

Carlos Alcaraz is the defending champion.[1] This will mark his first singles appearance in over four months, following a wrist injury he suffered at the Barcelona Open.[2]

Novak Djokovic is attempting to become the first player to win a record 25th major title.[3]

This tournament marked the first absence from a major of current world No. 1 Jannik Sinner since the 2019 Wimbledon Championships.[4]

This tournament will mark the final major appearances of 2016 champion, three-time major champion and former world No. 3 Stan Wawrinka and former world No. 6 Gaël Monfils.[5][a]
